panels.title: Locker EC2 CPU utilisation
panels.description: Host CPU of the card-vault EC2 instance (AWS/EC2, 1-min via detailed monitoring). The vault is not in Kubernetes, so container_cpu_* does not cover it.

panels.title: Locker EC2 CPU credit balance
panels.description: Burstable (t3) credit balance. Near zero under load = throttled to the 20% baseline. This metric stops existing once the instance moves to a non-burstable type — an empty panel after the upgrade is itself the confirmation.
